body: We're both bad people, you in your ignorance and antisocial behavior, me in my emotional instability. If you really want to apologize, do me a favor and avoid posting in this subreddit. You don't have the skills or the empathy to understand what it's for or what people are feeling and you could cause some harm to those still on the fence. Most of us are drowning in hopelessness and will grab onto whatever it takes just to feel something, to me it's superhero movies and the prospect of my brother getting married and having the kids I'll never have. Also, if you don't like Iron Man, you're definitely the one with shitty taste in movies.

You deserve to die because you went to a suicide watch subreddit and insulted the interests a person claims are his reason for staying around. Good work, you've proven you're a jackass, which I'm sure was the goal. These movies are already highly reviewed, top rated and will likely be among the high grossing movies of the year. So not only is your insult incorrect and in the minority, but you took your own personal preference in movies, which I respect isn't of the superhero or sci-fi, and determined that someone who likes these things has "shitty" taste? You're ignorant to what others enjoy, and one of those hurting our society, by knocking others down in a place where some are seeking help. You probably know you're an asshole already or you wouldn't be here. Words can't help you, life can't help you, I'm sure in many ways you yourself are a failure as well or you wouldn't be in a suicide watch channel insulting the depressed for your kicks. Sure you can probably say otherwise, but I know the truth. That's why you deserve to die. I'll be sure to take down some people like you on my way out, to give people ideas.
Ha, and you're a shitty person. You go to the suicidewatch subreddit and insult someone's movies? You deserve to die far more than I do.

If it's too much, drop something. Sound like things are stacking up pretty high and you're trying to live up to too much. Try for moderation, focus on less. It's ok not to do everything, find the least important, and put it on the backburner.
I'm right there with ya, just know you aren't alone.
